statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); let psi := fun (q a x : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 x).filter (fun n => n%q=a%q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n; ∀ q x : ℕ, 0<q → (∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => q ∣ n^2+1), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) = ∑ r ∈ (roots 1 q).filter (fun r => Nat.Coprime r q), (psi q r (2*x) - psi q r x)
